 facebook twitter News EXCLUSIVE: Fandango announces its free streaming titles and major film debuts for November
 You'll be able to watch top films, including 'The Odyssey,' 'Oppenheimer' and 'Forgotten Island.'
 Written by Shaye Weaver Contributor, Time Out New York Tuesday October 27 2026 Share Copy Link Facebook Twitter Pinterest Email WhatsApp Universal Pictures | Christopher Nolan’s The Odyssey explores an ancient Greek code of hospitality known as xenia. Advertising November’s looking like the perfect time to get hooked into a new show and watch movies you’ve been wanting to see—especially because Fandango ’s got a lot on the docket. And we’ve got the exclusive details. 
 The movie ticketer/review site/streamer has new transactional video-on-demand (TVOD) multi-studio franchise bundles, anticipated digital releases and a giant slate of free ad-supported streaming (AVOD) titles spanning blockbuster cinema, family entertainment and acclaimed classics—and it’s adding more this month. 
 RECOMMENDED :  You can now watch free movies on Fandango without an account 
 Major franchises are now available, including The Terminator, Vin Diesel’s xXx, Pacific Rim, My Big Fat Greek Wedding and Highlander . The Odyssey will also become available on November 17, as well as a preorder on a Zach Cregger /Resident Evil cross-studio bundle of Barbarian, Weapons and Resident Evil (2026), and a Dog Heroes/Man’s Best Friend bundle with Heart of the Beast, Arthur the King and Megan Leavey . 
 Fandango will also discount several exclusive bundles for the first time as part of Fandango’s Black Friday campaign. 
 When it comes to free-to-stream, Godzilla (1998) will make its Fandango debut, timed to the theatrical release of Godzilla Minus Zero .  Gladiator and The Departed, celebrating its 20th anniversary year, will also be available. 
 Fandango also tells Time Out that it will have exclusive rights to stream Trolls Band Together, Migration, The Fablemans, Fast X, and Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken throughout November. 
 Want to see more? 
 Here’s Fandango’s November streaming slate: 
 Franchises available on demand (on now): 
 The Terminator   
 xXx   
 Pacific Rim  
 My Big Fat Greek Wedding 
 Highlander 
 For Black Friday , select exclusive multi-studio bundles will be discounted for the first time. 
 New digital releases on demand: 
 Forgotten Island (2026) - available October 27 
 The Odyssey (2026) - available November 17  
 Free streaming titles (available November 1) 
 Godzilla (1998) — this is the first time you can stream it for free on Fandango. It’s timed to the upcoming theatrical release of Godzilla Minus Zero . 
 Gladiator (2000) — this is also this film’s first time streaming for free on Fandango, celebrating The Odyssey ’s arrival on demand. 
 Trolls Band Together (2023) — Fandango is exclusively streaming this in November.  
 Migration (2023) —  Fandango is exclusively streaming this in November. 
 The Departed (2006) — This is the film’s first time streaming for free on Fandango to celebrate its 20th anniversary.  
 The Fabelmans (2022) 
 Free Birds (2013) 
 The Family (2013) 
 The Chronicles of Narnia: The Voyage of the Dawn Treader (2010) 
 The Passion of the Christ (2004) 
 The Princess Bride (1987) 
 Three Kings (1999) — for Veterans Day 
 The Thin Red Line (1998) — for Veterans Day 
 The Fifth Element (1997) 
 The November Man (2014) 
 The Quick and The Dead (1995) 
 The Shack (2017) 
 Brothers (2009) 
 Click (2006) 
 Cloverfield (2008) 
 Clueless (1995) 
 Ghost Rider (2007) 
 Gifted (2017) 
 Law Abiding Citizen (2009) 
 Safety Not Guaranteed (2012) 
 Speed (1994) 
 Two Weeks Notice (2002) 
 We Own the Night (2007) 
 White Bird (2023) 
 Reagan (2024) — available November 4, exclusive free streaming on Fandango 
 Anna Pigeon  — available November 8. The complete first season available to stream free, following the announcement of the series’ second-season renewal. 
 Asteroid City (2023) — available November 9  
 The Killers Game (2024) — available November 12 
 Never Let Go (2024) — available November 19  
 Ruby Gillman, Teenage Kraken (2023) — available November 25, exclusive free streaming on Fandango 
 Fast X (2023) — available November 26, exclusive free streaming on Fandango 
 Additional free streaming highlights (a vailable now) 
 The Rainmaker — season 1 available to stream free while new episodes from season 2 continue to premiere weekly. 
 Oppenheimer (2023) 
 Check it all out and plan your November viewing on Fandango .
